triggers.description: Bare Actuating reconciles implementation, publication, review, and closure.
Explicit bounded routes select implement, triage, remediation-plan, or review-closeout.
A current witnessed falsifier may expose a semantic hotspot or architecture defect.
exclusions: isolated mechanical mistake inside an already-correct owner
environment failure with no semantic boundary implication

triggers.description: A current witness may falsify an exact eliminated family claim inside its validity horizon.
Unqualified review, inspect, audit, or classify intent is non-mutating triage.

routes.description: Acquire and classify evidence without mutation.
Resolve review pressure, publish when required, and converge.
Hand exact Git and validation facts to Ship.

required_artifacts: owner-issued validation, review, and publication evidence when applicable
success_signals: Git is the realized construction
CAS owns review attempts
Ship owns public effects
Actuating keeps no durable workflow store
failure_signals: Actuating copies owner facts into an event log
a stored Actuating verdict outranks current owner state
Ledger grants mutation, review credit, or closure
clauses.rationale: Durable facts stay with their owners and interpretations are recomputed.

success_signals: entailed findings may become current counterexamples
strengthening remains non-blocking until adopted
preference is rejected as current liability
new requirement reopens Goal authority
underdetermined requirement blocks pending authority
failure_signals: review prose silently authors a Goal law
optional strengthening prevents closure
preference is implemented as correctness work
new requirement is patched without authority
clauses.rationale: Review may falsify accepted semantics but may not continuously expand them.

required_artifacts: entailed law when current pressure is claimed
family predicate, admission relation, owner model, cut, validity horizon, and claim strength
exhaustive-domain basis or sibling predictions and probes
success_signals: a bug is a witness rather than a patch instruction or complete family
theory is challenged when detection-shaped or violation-erasing
family theory predicts unobserved siblings or proves an exhaustive domain
architecture is selected by concrete invalidity excluded and valid behavior preserved
failure_signals: observed examples are treated as the complete family
passing repaired examples is called family elimination
newly discovered siblings are relabeled as prior predictions
a hotspot registry or durable store is created
clauses.rationale: A generative theory must explain and predict the invalid class, not merely compress past findings.

required_artifacts: current entailed witness that falsifies the exact family claim inside its validity horizon
successor sibling predictions or exhaustive-domain proof
success_signals: prior eliminated disposition is revoked immediately on a same-claim falsifier
same-law disjoint families and out-of-horizon witnesses do not revoke the scoped claim
mutation waits for failed-premise localization
theory is retained only for localized realization/proof failure
theory/admission/interpretation/owner is revised when its premise failed
unknown failure location returns unresolved
successor elimination uses accepted Goal authority, family-level proof, and sibling probes
failure_signals: post-elimination witness becomes another patch under the unchanged claim
elimination remains live after a current same-claim counterexample
failed premise is not named
successor elimination is issued from repaired examples alone
elimination is reissued while Goal authority remains reopened
clauses.rationale: A post-elimination counterexample is evidence that the prior correctness claim failed.

required_artifacts: incumbent model reconstructed from the current tree
Architecture Working Set when selection reopens
correctness Pareto frontier before cost minimization
success_signals: isolated realization defect preserves an already-correct owner
theory or architecture reopens before mutation when a premise failed
Universalist nominates and Actuating selects
material incomparability remains explicit
failure_signals: new semantics hide inside a realization repair
candidate wins by moving detection
post-elimination same-theory accretion is presented as convergence
prior analysis substitutes for current repository evidence
clauses.rationale: Architecture selection minimizes admitted incorrectness without losing required valid behavior.

required_artifacts: exact CAS receipts for the current Git head
success_signals: initial standard plus four compact auxiliaries launch concurrently
five consecutive standard cleans bind the exact unchanged head
material head change invalidates credit by identity
missing resumable evidence restarts a fresh wave
failure_signals: review count is reconstructed from prose
review evidence is copied into an Actuating store
review findings bypass law-authority classification
clauses.rationale: CAS receipts own attempt facts; Review Fold and Actuating interpret them.

required_artifacts: current Goal, Git head, validation, publication, and CAS evidence when required
current counterexample theory, validity horizon, and proof
explicit eliminated, contained, obstructed, or unresolved disposition
success_signals: closure is reevaluated from live owner facts
unadopted strengthening and preference do not expand the Goal
post-elimination lease is revoked and adjudicated
successor elimination includes family-level proof and sibling probes
no closure receipt is required
failure_signals: stored completion survives changed inputs
review authors new required semantics
repaired examples substitute for family exclusion
a revoked elimination claim reaches closure
publication or process exit substitutes for proof
clauses.rationale: Completion is a head-relative correctness predicate whose falsifiers are dispositionally binding.

instrumentation.rationale: Actuating reports a live judgment over owner facts and creates no peer authority artifact.
